query:
WITH del AS (
                    DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = $1 AND followee_id = $2 RETURNING 1
                )
                SELECT coalesce(s.followers_count, 0) - (SELECT count(*) FROM del) AS "followers_count!"
                FROM profiles p
                LEFT JOIN profile_stats s ON s.user_id = p.user_id
                WHERE p.user_id = $2
